response.sql: WITH overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(amount) as overall_average FROM trans), account_avg AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) as avg_amount FROM trans GROUP BY account_id) SELECT account_avg.account_id, account_avg.avg_amount, account_avg.avg_amount - overall_avg.overall_average as excess FROM account_avg, overall_avg WHERE account_avg.avg_amount > overall_avg.overall_average ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10;
